proposal.council_source: the term's mayor-election candidates and ballots
proposal.council_members: the winner plus the other two candidates, in candidate ID order
proposal.invalid_authority: No proposal or payment when mayor, term, or any council member is missing
proposal.stale_term: Reject authorization if term identity changes before payment; retain a paid project through later terms

finance.funding_recheck: Before payment, town_coin - cost must be at least max(proposal reserve snapshot, current fiscal_policy().subsidy_floor)
finance.post_approval_insufficient_funds: Terminal unfunded result for this term; no partial payment or automatic later charge

construction.start_requires: approved proposal and exactly one validated pay receipt
construction.complete_requires: underway state, matching payment receipt, and tick_no >= due_tick
construction.term_rollover: Continue already paid construction without another vote or charge

projects.missing_config: No proposal, payment, project events, visual changes, or change to baseline simulation
